serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a government-community cloud architected to provide U.S. public sector entities with best-in-class security and industry leading price-performance. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services are a set of complementary infrastructure and platform cloud services that enable customers to build and run their enterprise workloads through high-performance, secure, and available services that scale elastically. With Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, public sector entities can use Oracle development tools to enhance existing applications while creating and integrating new cloud-native applications.
